claims.disproof_condition: 條件：OCI MSA 後續版本（v1.1 以後）允許模組或引擎內建雷射取代 ELS，或主要成員宣布 OCI 產品不用 ELSFP。核查頻率：每半年（oci-msa.org 規格頁、OFC／OCP）。觸發後 48 小時：e1 加註或提撤回，重讀外部光源層的需求側與反向路徑（ew_0722 那一條）。
claims.statement: OCI MSA v1.0 (2026-03-11; editors AMD, Broadcom & Meta), the open optical scale-up interconnect spec for 'the AI scale-up domain': §2.5 'The OCI implementation shall use an ELS in compliance with the OIF ELSFP implementation'; the ELS provides the light to both transmitter groups. A written standard mandating external laser sources for OCI scale-up links — it contradicts the OCP 2026 oral remark that OCI does not need an external laser source; the written spec governs.

source_doc.title: OCI MSA, 200G Optical Compute Interconnect Line Interface Specification v1.0（2026-03-11；編者 AMD、Broadcom、Meta）節錄：scale-up 用途與 §2.5 外部光源

sources.quote: v1.0 03/11/2026 AMD, Broadcom & Meta 1. Release version

To reduce the fiber connectivity and density challenges of the AI scale-up domain, each fiber supports a bidirectional link with both transmit and receive signals counter-propagating on the same fiber.
The OCI implementation shall use an ELS in compliance with the OIF ELSFP implementation and with the specifications provided in Table 2-6.
The external laser source (ELS) provides the light to the group A and group B transmitters for modulation.
